method_notice: Quaternion camera tracking lag is separated from residual target error caused by the forward-view cone. Slowdown follows predicted feasible tracking lag and relative angular demand. Holds are simulated from current joint state and added only if the feasible goal settles within 1.2 s; total holds are capped at 3 percent of original duration, with 8 s cooldown and 24 deg entry threshold. Slowdown is capped at 1.25 time dilation and ignores tracking lag below 15 deg. This is offline state simulation, not live image feedback. Four ablation modes share geometry and evaluation thresholds.
